## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passed
- [ ] Relevant journey tested at `http://localhost:8000` (if UI/server changed)
- [ ] Mobile widths and browser console checked (if UI changed)
- [ ] Live-service behavior checked or explicitly marked unverified (if API changed)

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is limited and unrelated changes are excluded
- [ ] Farmer-facing claims have source IDs, limitations, and correct approval status
- [ ] Missing data and remote-service failures remain visible
- [ ] No field measurements or outcomes are inferred from coarse data
- [ ] Privacy impact and coordinate transmission are documented (if changed)
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` and decisions updated where needed
- [ ] Student-visible commits include a `Devlog:` trailer

## Remaining limitations

List any unverified behavior or required human review.
